body.statement: Uniformly over every compact subset of observed laws from \(\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\) satisfying \(\ker(A_P)\subseteq\ker(R_0)\), \(\operatorname{rank}(A_P)=r\), and \(\sigma_r(M_P)\ge\kappa\), the vector \(\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta)\) is asymptotically Gaussian with covariance \(V(P,\lambda)\), the plug-in covariance is uniformly consistent, and the resulting joint Wald ellipsoid has coverage converging uniformly to \(1-\alpha\). The derivative is invariant to the representative \(g_*\).
body.justification: The theorem supplies ordinary root-\(n\) inference when rank is separated without pretending that the bridge itself is unique.
body.gap: Bennett et al. and Zhang et al. give regular inference for strongly identified functionals of nonunique nuisances, but not the finite multigraph derivative and its cancellation across a fixed deficient-rank stratum.
body.consumer: Analysts obtain regular finite-dimensional Wald inference in well-conditioned network strata while retaining the exact identification criterion.
